description: Non-negotiable identity cues and reusable geometry kits for the twenty world-class LEGO pilot archetypes.

london_heritage_mansion_block.identity: Portland-stone mansion block with a composed centre pavilion, giant bay windows, wrought-iron balcony datum and inhabited mansard skyline.
london_heritage_mansion_block.material_zones: rusticated pale-stone base; dressed-stone middle; dark slate mansard; bronze-black metalwork

parisian_midrise_block.identity: Haussmann boulevard block with a tall shopfront base, ordered French windows, two continuous iron balconies, deep cornice and slate mansard dormers.
parisian_midrise_block.material_zones: warm limestone; black iron balconies; dark slate roof; restrained awnings at street level

parisian_boulevard_corner.identity: Parisian corner landmark with a rounded corner pavilion, wraparound balconies, strong horizontal stone courses and a turreted mansard crown.
parisian_boulevard_corner.material_zones: cream limestone; zinc-grey roof; black iron; darker rusticated base

civic_classical_building.identity: Civic classical composition with a dominant central pedimented portico, giant-order columns, broad ceremonial stairs and symmetrical stone wings.
civic_classical_building.material_zones: monolithic pale limestone; shadowed entrance portal; bronze doors; lead-grey roof

monumental_courthouse_axis.identity: Axial courthouse with a projecting temple front, tall fluted colonnade, deep entablature, judicial stair and severe symmetrical wings.
monumental_courthouse_axis.material_zones: light granite and limestone; bronze entrance doors; dark recessed glazing

collegiate_gothic_education.identity: Collegiate Gothic hall with a crenellated central tower, buttressed bays, pointed entrance arch, tracery-like verticals and steep slate roofs.
collegiate_gothic_education.material_zones: weathered buff stone; dark tracery; slate roofs; oxidized metal accents

classic_brownstone_streetwall.identity: New York brownstone row with individual stoops, high parlor floors, projecting oriels, carved lintels and a heavy bracketed cornice.
classic_brownstone_streetwall.material_zones: warm brownstone; black iron stoops; dark timber doors; shadowed basement

historical_brick_main_street.identity: Narrow historic main-street building with a transparent cast-iron storefront, brick pilasters, sign frieze, punched sash windows and pressed-metal cornice.
historical_brick_main_street.material_zones: variegated red brick; painted cast iron; glazed shopfront; dark metal cornice

industrial_brick_mixed_use.identity: Robust industrial brick loft with broad steel windows, expressed brick piers, loading-bay canopy, concrete lintels and roof monitor.
industrial_brick_mixed_use.material_zones: deep red brick; blackened steel; board-formed concrete; weathered metal

adaptive_reuse_warehouse_lofts.identity: Converted warehouse retaining heavy masonry piers while inserting large steel-and-glass bays, roof monitor, terraces and selective industrial bracing.
adaptive_reuse_warehouse_lofts.material_zones: aged brick; charcoal steel; large reflective glass; weathered concrete

romanesque_revival_warehouse.identity: Richardsonian warehouse with a massive round-arched base, grouped arched openings, deep voussoirs, heavy masonry piers and corbelled cornice.
romanesque_revival_warehouse.material_zones: dark rock-faced stone and red brick; deep window shadows; copper accents

art_deco_setback_tower.identity: Vertical Art Deco tower with a richly modelled entrance, uninterrupted piers, stepped setbacks, fluted spandrels and an illuminated geometric crown.
art_deco_setback_tower.material_zones: warm buff masonry; dark bronze; emerald and gold crown accents; shadowed spandrels

nordic_timber_midrise.identity: Nordic natural midrise with silvered-charred larch field, vertically continuous warm timber balcony bays, thick picture frames, stone base and a delicate roof rail.
nordic_timber_midrise.material_zones: charcoal silvered larch field; honey larch feature bays; grey coursed-stone base; black metal rails

scandinavian_urban_residential.identity: Quiet Scandinavian apartment building with pale masonry field, deep timber-lined loggias, projecting window frames, subtle asymmetry and a crisp pitched roof edge.
scandinavian_urban_residential.material_zones: pale mineral render and brick; warm timber reveals; muted metal roof; dark frames

mediterranean_arcade_mixed_use.identity: Mediterranean mixed-use palazzo with a deep ground arcade, shaded upper loggias, stucco wall field, stone trim and generous terracotta eaves.
mediterranean_arcade_mixed_use.material_zones: sun-washed stucco; warm stone arches; dark timber shutters; terracotta roof

japanese_machiya_mixed_use.identity: Contemporary machiya with a narrow timber structural rhythm, deep eaves, translucent lattice screens, recessed shopfront and layered threshold.
japanese_machiya_mixed_use.material_zones: smoked timber; warm cedar lattice; charcoal plaster; translucent glass

modernist_civic_block.identity: Monumental modernist civic block with a floating upper volume, pilotis, deep brise-soleil, ceremonial cantilever canopy and exposed concrete frame.
modernist_civic_block.material_zones: board-marked concrete; dark bronze frames; clear glass; warm soffit

modern_glass_office_institutional.identity: High-performance glass institution with a double-height lobby, expressed curtain-wall mullions, vertical solar fins, transparent corners and rooftop pergola.
modern_glass_office_institutional.material_zones: low-iron glass; charcoal aluminum; pale stone base; warm lobby soffit

chateauesque_grand_railway_hotel.identity: Grand railway hotel with a powerful central pavilion, corner turrets, steep copper-and-slate roofscape, dense dormers, chimneys and porte-cochere arrival.
chateauesque_grand_railway_hotel.material_zones: warm sandstone; greened copper and slate; dark iron; glowing grand windows

eixample_apartment_block.identity: Barcelona Eixample apartment block with chamfered-corner emphasis, repetitive wrought-iron balconies, carved stone portal, glazed galleries and a deep cornice.
eixample_apartment_block.material_zones: warm carved stone and stucco; black iron; timber shutters; darker stone base
